data.title: Add --tree flag to docket list
data.body:
Show all bugs as a dependency forest in the list view.

```
$ docket list --tree

Dependency trees:

abc1: Implement user auth [Approved, P1]
├── def2: Set up database schema [InProgress, P2]
└── jkl4: Design API endpoints [Approved, P2]

xyz9: Standalone bug [Draft, P2]

uvw3: Another root [Approved, P1]
└── rst4: Its dependency [Done] ✓
```

## Behavior

- Group bugs into trees based on dependency relationships
- Bugs with no dependencies and no dependents shown as standalone
- Respects existing filters (--status, --priority, etc.)
- Consider: should this be default view or opt-in flag?

## Depends on

Requires the core tree rendering logic from `docket tree <id>`.
